Yaz's Meal Prep is made for everyone. Whether you're an avid workout enthusiast, or just looking to fuel your body with health in mind, this is for you.

Things to Know

A quick guide to reheating and storing your meals safely.

How to Reheat Your Meal

All containers excluding dessert containers provided by Yaz's Meal Prep are microwave-safe and dishwasher-safe.

Microwave:

  1. Remove lid or vent it slightly.
  2. Reheat to an internal temperature of 165°F.
  3. Heat on high for 2-3 minutes, stirring halfway through.
  4. Let it sit 1 minute before serving (containers will be hot).

Freezer Storage Guidelines

All meals are prepared fresh and can be refrigerated for up to 4 days or frozen for extended storage.

For best quality, we recommend:

  • Freeze meals within 2 days of receiving if not eating within the week.
  • Consume frozen meals within 2-3 months for optimal taste and texture.
  • Meals containing cream-based sauces (Alfredo, Mac & Cheese, etc.) are best consumed within 1-2 months of freezing, as dairy-based sauces may change texture over longer storage.

Thawing and Reheating:

  • Thaw overnight in the refrigerator before reheating.
  • Reheat to an internal temperature of 165°F.
  • Do not refreeze thawed meals.

Meals stored properly at 0°F remain safe to eat beyond these windows, but flavor and texture are best within the timeframes above.

Allergen Disclaimer

All meals are prepared in a home/commercial kitchen that handles milk, eggs, wheat, soy, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, and peanuts. While we take care in preparation, our meals are not certified allergen-free and cross-contact may occur.

Please review ingredient lists carefully before ordering if you have a food allergy or sensitivity. A full ingredient breakdown is available for every meal upon request.

If you have a severe or life-threatening allergy, please contact us directly before ordering to discuss your specific concerns.

Instructions For Payment

  1. Submit your order — your device will autopopulate an email with your order details.

  4. Send a Venmo payment for your total, with the Y# in the description.
  5. A second email will autopopulate so you can keep a copy for yourself, if you'd like.
  6. Read the Additional Notes below before placing your order.
